description: Fully responsive interactive brass two-pan weighing scale for Grade 7 algebra (Ch 7: Finding the Unknown). Singularity Design System (Poppins, #4A4DC9 indigo + #FF7212 orange). Photorealistic brass scale with bell base, fleur-de-lis crown, 4 fanning chains, wide saucer pans. 10 practice problems. No teaching notes banner. Adapts to all screen sizes 320px–1200px+.
topic: Unknown Weights on Traditional Weighing Scales (Fig 7.9 to 7.12)

responsive.approach: ResizeObserver-based container width detection with isMobile (<500px) and isSmall (<650px) breakpoints
responsive.scaleSVG: Uses viewBox='0 0 600 400' with width:100% and aspectRatio:600/400 — scales to any container
responsive.items: Icon sizes adapt: 34px desktop, 28px tablet, 24px mobile. Count labels scale too.
responsive.typography: Font sizes, paddings, gaps all conditionally sized per breakpoint
responsive.layout: flexWrap on all button rows, input row stays flex with minWidth:0, header text truncates with ellipsis
responsive.buttons: Pill buttons shrink padding on mobile. Check button hides label text on mobile (icon only).
responsive.dots: Problem dots shrink from 30px to 26px on mobile
responsive.containerWidth: width:100% with maxWidth from props (default 800px), no fixed px width

designSystem.name: Singularity
designSystem.icons: lucide-react: Check, X, ChevronRight, ChevronLeft, RotateCcw, Trophy, BookOpen, Target, HelpCircle, Star

width.description: Max width in pixels. Container uses width:100% up to this max.

height.description: Min height on desktop. Mobile uses auto.

problems.description: Custom problems array. Default: 10 built-in problems.

learn.description: 5-step guided walkthrough. No teaching notes banner. Cards with emoji icons, equation previews for steps 3-5.

practice.description: 10 interactive problems. No teaching notes banner. Brass scale, equation input, instant validation, hints, show-answer, dot nav, score tracker.

scaleVisualDesign.type: Photorealistic brass balance in a single SVG with viewBox for responsiveness
scaleVisualDesign.beam: 540 units wide, rotates via SVG <g transform>
scaleVisualDesign.chains: 4 fanning dashed lines per side, inside the rotating <g>
scaleVisualDesign.pans: Elliptical saucers (rx=82) with inner highlight, inside rotating <g>
scaleVisualDesign.items: Overlaid via absolute-positioned divs with % positioning, rotate with beam via CSS transform

teaching_notes: No teaching notes banner in either mode. Teaching content is embedded in the Learn mode cards themselves.
instructions_for_student: Translate a two-pan balance scenario into an algebraic equation using x for the unknown.
generation_prompt: Standalone interaction where a two-pan balance image is shown with a sack and standard iron weights. Students type the algebraic equation using x for the unknown. Instant validation provided.
